title: Cap. IX Arg. 13 Sol: unknown elect/non-elect — Augustine: affection of charity must will all saved; rebuke all lest they perish (De corrept. et grat.)
pass_a_gloss: But this ought not to hinder or retard the labor of ministers, because, as Augustine piously and prudently, De corrept. et grat. cap. 15. and 16. not knowing who belongs unto the number of the predestined, who does not belong, they ought so to be affected with the affection of charity, that they will all to be saved. Accordingly as far as pertains unto us, who cannot discern the predestined from the non-predestined, rebuke is to be applied unto all lest they perish, or lest they destroy others.
pass_b_english: But that ought not to hinder or slow ministers' labor. As Augustine says piously and wisely (De corrept. et grat. cap. 15–16): not knowing who belongs to the number of the predestined and who does not, they ought to be so moved by charity that they will all to be saved. So far as concerns us, who cannot tell the predestined from the non-predestined, rebuke is to be applied to all, lest they perish or destroy others.
source_text: Sed hoc non debet impedire aut retardare operam ministrorum, quia, ut pie et prudenter Augustinus, De corrept. et grat. cap. 15. et 16. nescientes quis pertineat ad praedestinatorum numerum, quis non pertineat, sic affici debent charitatis affectu, ut omnes velint salvos fieri. Proinde quantum ad nos pertinet, qui praedestinatos a non praedestinatis discernere non valemus, omnibus ne pereant, vel ne alios perdant, adhibenda est correptio.
